Nearly every ticket you will work requires an intersection of strong technical knowledge and customer empathy to understand what the customer needs and how to get them there. - Airflow and data engineering

- Kubernetes

- 4 years of experience with Python

- Experience with Kubernetes/Docker/Containers

- Experience working with a distributed system with any major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure)

- Problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities

- Ability to work well with autonomy and independence

- Strong written and verbal communication for connecting with our customers over our ticketing system and through Zoom

- Experience mentoring junior team members

 

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

- Contributions to open-source projects

- Customer Support experience

- Familiarity with SQL and PostgreSQL

- Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, dbt, or other similar data engineer

We’re looking for a curious, creative, and detail-driven Electrical Designer to join our 
engineering team. If you love solving complex problems, enjoy turning ideas into real-world 
electrical systems, and get a thrill from seeing your designs come to life on the shop floor, 
you’ll fit right in. 

In this role, you’ll design and develop custom switchgear systems-translating customer 
needs into clear, accurate electrical and mechanical designs. You’ll create installation 
plans, produce engineering documentation, and ensure every layout, schematic, and 
component meets the highest standards for performance, safety, and compliance. You’ll 
collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and project teams to deliver solutions that 
are reliable, cost-effective, and built to last. 

About Us 
Sabre is where big ideas meet big power. We’re an electrical manufacturing and integration 
company that supports complex power-distribution and electrical-integration projects 
across North America. Our teams blend engineering, manufacturing, and project execution 
into one fast-moving, schedule-driven operation. If you like solving real-world challenges, 
working with sharp people, and seeing your designs turn into hardware that actually moves 
electrons, you’ll feel right at home here. 

What Do Electrical Designers Do? 
Electrical Designers at Sabre are the people who turn concepts into reality. 

You will: 
• Design electrical panel schematics and manufacturing outputs. 
• Translate customer input into clear product requirements. 
• Apply industry standards and regulatory requirements with confidence. 
• Select and specify electrical components that make systems work flawlessly. 
• Perform DFMEA, derating, arc-fault, and heat-loss calculations. 
• Create detailed concept and production drawings. 
• Participate in design reviews and contribute your expertise. 
• Support and mentor junior engineers and technologists. 

Duties 
You’ll take ownership of designing and developing electrical components and systems for 
custom switchgear products, including: 
• Circuit breakers, disconnect switches, busbars, and enclosures. 
• LV/MV switchgear using ACBs, VCBs, SF6 breakers, MCCs, and e-houses. 
• Welded cells, bolted parts, and busbar systems that integrate purchased 
components. 
• Reviewing customer specifications, sales quotes, vendor documentation, drawings, 
and diagrams.
